title: RationalCraft
description: This makes the original synthesis recipe more reasonable
body:
A Minecraft Fabric mod that modifies an unreasonable original recipe and adds missing recipes.



Changes Included:

• Stairs: 3 blocks to make 4 stairs (originally 6), 2 × 2 to combine them

• Signboard: 1 Half-Brick + 1 Stick to make 1 Signboard

• Carpet: 2 wool to make 6 carpets (originally 3)

• Glass panels: 4 glass pieces combined into 12 glass panels (originally 6 → 16)

• Cutting copper: 4 copper blocks make 16 cut copper

• Half Brick: Added 2 blocks to combine into 4 half blocks, and 2 half blocks to reverse to merge into 1 block



New content:

• Stone cutters can process wood (planks→ half-bricks/stairs/fences)

• Stone cutters can peel logs

• Stone cutters can remove copper rust and apply wax

• The stone cutter can break down various blocks (coral, quartz, ice, drip stone, amethyst, etc.)

• The blast furnace can recover metal products as corresponding ingots per pellet

• The furnace can burn wool into dye

• Chests/Funnels/Shadow Boxes can be crafted using barrels instead

• Chain armor can be crafted using iron chains

• Deepslate can be converted from cobblestone in blast furnaces to achieve renewability
